meanings.usage: 指充气后能飘浮在空中的球状物，常用于娱乐或侦察

meanings.meaning: 飞行员（指驾驶飞机的人） verb. 驾驶/领航
meanings.usage: 指驾驶飞机或引导船只
指军事设施、警局或火车站等
飞机的总称，复数形式仍为aircraft

meanings.meaning: 间谍/特工（指从事情报工作的人） verb. 侦察/窥探
meanings.usage: 指暗中监视或收集情报

meanings.meaning: 追踪/跟踪（keep track of 意为'追踪/掌握...的动态'） noun. 轨迹/轨道
照片（指拍摄得到的图片） verb. 拍照

meanings.usage: 指从高处向低处移动，是ascend的反义词
指供飞机起飞降落的地方，比airport规模小

meanings.meaning: 逮捕/拘留（指依法扣押嫌疑人） noun. 逮捕

meanings.usage: 指令人费解或不知原因的事情

phrases.usage: 驶向/走向某地，表示朝某个方向前进

examples.en: The balloon seemed to be making for the RAF station.
examples.zh: 气球似乎正朝皇家空军基地飘去。

phrases.usage: 追踪/掌握...的动态，保持对某事的了解

examples.en: The pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
examples.zh: 飞行员被命令追踪那个奇怪的物体。

phrases.usage: 辨认出/看清楚/理解，常用于表示看清或辨认某物

examples.en: He could make out three men in a basket.
examples.zh: 他辨认出篮子里有三个人。

phrases.usage: 召来/召集/叫来，指请求某人或某物前来帮助
不久之后，表示紧接着发生的动作

examples.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend.
examples.zh: 不久之后，气球开始下降。

phrases.usage: 对...很大的危险，danger后接介词to引出危险对象

examples.en: Balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
examples.zh: 气球可能对飞机造成很大危险。

phrases.usage: 盘旋/环绕飞行，指绕着某物做圆周运动

examples.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
examples.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球盘旋了一会儿。

phrases.usage: 拍照/摄影，指用相机拍摄照片的动作

examples.en: One of the men was taking photographs.

phrases.usage: 立即/马上，表示即刻发生的动作

examples.en: He informed the station at once.

phrases.usage: 对...生气，angry后接介词with再加对象

examples.en: The officer was very angry when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 军官听到这个消息后非常生气。

phrases.usage: /kənˈtrəʊl ˈtaʊə(r)/ noun. 指挥塔（机场或军事基地中用于指挥飞机起降的建筑）
/kəˈmɑːndɪŋ ˈɒfɪsə(r)/ noun. 指挥官/司令官（军队中的最高指挥官，常缩写为C.O.）
/ˈmembə(r) əv ˈpɑːləmənt/ noun. 国会议员（英国议会的下议院议员，简称MP）

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作 用于描述正在进行的动作，或与一般过去时连用表示一个动作发生时另一个动作正在进行。通常与when、while、as等连用。

examples.en: The balloon seemed to be making for the RAF station.
examples.zh: 气球似乎正朝皇家空军基地飘去。

examples.en: One of the men was taking photographs.
While the pilot was circling the balloon, he saw three men.
examples.zh: 当飞行员绕着气球盘旋时，他看到了三个人。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即'过去的过去' 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时。常与before、after、by、when等连用。

examples.en: He had never seen anything like it before.
examples.zh: 他以前从未见过这样的东西。

examples.en: When the police arrived, the balloon had already landed.
examples.zh: 警察到达时，气球已经降落了。

grammar.title: when引导的时间状语从句
grammar.structure: 主句 + when + 从句 / when + 从句 + 主句
grammar.definition: when引导的从句表示主句动作发生的时间 when引导的从句中，如果动作正在进行（长动作），用过去进行时；如果动作发生（短动作），用一般过去时。主句用一般过去时。

examples.en: The officer was very angry when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 军官听到消息时非常生气。

examples.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
examples.zh: 当气球飞临基地上空时，飞行员看到其中一人正在拍照。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + when + 主语 + 动词-ed

original.en: The officer was very angry when he heard the news.
original.zh: 军官听到消息时非常生气。

imitations.en: The pilot was watching the balloon when it began to descend.
imitations.zh: 飞行员正在观察气球时，它开始下降了。

imitations.en: I was having dinner when the phone rang.
imitations.zh: 我正在吃晚饭时电话响了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + could make out + 宾语

original.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it.
original.zh: 他能辨认出气球下面篮子里有三个人。

imitations.en: From the plane, he could make out the coastline.
imitations.zh: 从飞机上他能辨认出海岸线。

imitations.en: I could make out a figure in the distance.
imitations.zh: 我能辨认出远处有一个人影。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be ordered to + 动词原形

original.en: The pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
original.zh: 飞行员被命令追踪那个奇怪的物体。

imitations.en: The soldiers were ordered to march forward.
imitations.zh: 士兵们被命令向前行进。

imitations.en: He was ordered to report to the commander immediately.
imitations.zh: 他被命令立即向指挥官报到。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 形容词 + when + 从句

original.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news.
original.zh: 指挥塔里的军官听到消息时非常生气。

imitations.en: She was surprised when she saw the result.
The teacher was delighted when the students answered correctly.
imitations.zh: 学生正确回答时老师很高兴。

lines.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force Station nearby.
lines.zh: 一个飞行员发现了一只气球，它像是正飞往附近的一个皇家空军基地。

lines.en: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
lines.zh: 他马上把情况报告了该基地，但那里的人没有一个能解释这到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news, because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft .
lines.zh: 控制塔上的官员得知这一消息后，非常气愤，因为气球有可能给飞机造成极大的危险。

lines.en: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
lines.zh: 他说可能有人正对基地进行侦察，因此命令那个飞行员跟踪那个奇怪的飞行物。

lines.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
lines.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球飞了一阵。

lines.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars .
lines.zh: 他看清了气球下面有3个人呆在一只筐里，其中一个举着望远镜。

lines.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
lines.zh: 当气球飞临基地上空时，飞行员看见有一个人在拍照。

lines.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield .
lines.zh: 不久，气球开始降落，在一个停机坪附近着了陆。

lines.en: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone, for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
lines.zh: 警察被召来了，但他们却不能逮捕任何人，因为筐里是两名国会议员和一名基地的指挥官！

lines.en: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
lines.zh: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，基地的这半边不知道那半边正在干什么！

questions.q: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?
questions.zh: 基地的指挥官当时在哪里？
questions.a: He was in the basket of the balloon — he was one of the three men in the basket.
questions.aZh: 他就在气球的吊篮里，是篮中三个人之一。
questions.hint: 出处：课文最后一段——吊篮里有两位国会议员和基地指挥官。

questions.q: Why was the officer in the control tower angry when he heard the news?
questions.zh: 控制塔上的官员听到消息后为什么很生气？
questions.a: Because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
questions.aZh: 因为气球有可能给飞机造成极大的危险。
questions.hint: 出处：课文第3句 because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft。

questions.q: What did the pilot see one of the men doing when the balloon was over the station?
questions.zh: 当气球飞临基地上空时，飞行员看见其中一个人在做什么？
questions.a: He saw one of the men taking photographs.
questions.aZh: 他看见其中一个人在拍照。
questions.hint: 出处：课文第7句 saw one of the men taking photographs。

questions.q: Why could the police not arrest anyone after the balloon landed?
questions.zh: 气球降落后，警察为什么不能逮捕任何人？
questions.a: Because the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station.
questions.aZh: 因为吊篮里是两位国会议员和基地指挥官。
questions.hint: 出处：课文倒数第二句 the basket contained two Members of Parliament…

questions.q: What does 'one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing' suggest?
questions.zh: “基地的这半边不知道那半边在干什么”这句话暗示了什么？
questions.a: It humorously suggests that the station was so disorganized that its own Commanding Officer was spying on it from a balloon — the left hand did not know what the right hand was doing.
questions.aZh: 这句话幽默地暗示该基地管理混乱：连自家指挥官都坐着气球来“侦察”自己的基地，左右两边互不通气。
questions.hint: 线索：课文结尾处指挥官本人的解释。

translation:
一个飞行员发现了一只气球，它像是正飞往附近的一个皇家空军基地。
他马上把情况报告了该基地，但那里的人没有一个能解释这到底是怎么回事。
控制塔上的官员得知这一消息后，非常气愤，因为气球有可能给飞机造成极大的危险。
他说可能有人正对基地进行侦察，因此命令那个飞行员跟踪那个奇怪的飞行物。
飞行员设法绕着气球飞了一阵。
他看清了气球下面有3个人呆在一只筐里，其中一个举着望远镜。
当气球飞临基地上空时，飞行员看见有一个人在拍照。
不久，气球开始降落，在一个停机坪附近着了陆。
警察被召来了，但他们却不能逮捕任何人，因为筐里是两名国会议员和一名基地的指挥官！
正如指挥官后来解释的那样，基地的这半边不知道那半边正在干什么！
title: Three Men in a Basket
subtitle: 三人同篮

lead.question: 一只气球逼近空军基地，基地如临大敌，为何警察最后却抓不了人？
lead.warmup: 上世纪，气球侦察还是一种真实存在的威胁。一名飞行员发现一只气球似乎正飞往附近的皇家空军基地，立刻报告。基地如临大敌，控制塔官员大怒，命令飞行员紧盯这个“神秘飞行物”，看它在基地上空拍照，随后降落。警察赶来准备抓人，却发现吊篮里的“间谍”竟是自家指挥官和两位国会议员。故事把官僚体系的荒诞调侃得淋漓尽致。
goals: 掌握 make for / keep track of / make out / call in 等固定短语的含义与用法。
学会用 seem to be doing 和 might be doing 表达对正在进行动作的推测。
掌握 spy on、be able to do、manage to do、be ordered to do 等结构的用法。
理解课文幽默：基地指挥官竟来“侦察”自家基地，并学会用英语复述要点。
lead.summary: 一架飞机发现一只气球像要飞往附近的皇家空军基地，飞行员立即报告。控制塔官员大怒，担心有人侦察基地，命令飞行员跟踪辨认。飞行员绕气球飞行，看清吊篮里有三个人，一人举着望远镜；气球飞临基地上空时还有人在拍照。气球随后降落，警察赶来却无法抓人——篮中竟是两位国会议员和基地指挥官。正如他所说：基地这一半不知另一半在干什么。
lead.tips: 注意区分 make for（走向/飞往）、make out（辨认出）、make up（编造）、make up for（弥补）；seem 后接不定式进行式 to be doing 表示“似乎正在……”，不要写成 to doing。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他说可能有人正在对基地进行侦察。
exercises.a: He said that someone might be spying on the station.

exercises.q: 句型转换（用 seem）：A balloon was making for a station.
exercises.a: A balloon seemed to be making for a station.

exercises.q: 填空：The pilot was ordered to ____ ____ ____ the strange object.（跟踪）
改错：He managed circling the balloon for some time.
exercises.a: He managed to circle the balloon for some time.

exercises.q: 汉译英：他只能勉强辨认出吊篮里的三个人。
exercises.a: He could just make out three men in a basket.

exercises.q: 填空（用 spy 的正确形式）：Someone might be ____ ____ the station.
句型转换（用 be able to）：No one there could explain the mystery.
exercises.a: No one there was able to explain the mystery.
exercises.note: able 后接不定式作宾语

quiz.q: 气球“正飞往”皇家空军基地，用哪个短语？
options: making for
making out
making up
making up for

quiz.q: “He could make out three men in a basket.”中 make out 的意思是？
options: 勉强辨认出
编造出
补偿
走向

quiz.q: 哪一句正确表达“有人可能正在侦察基地”？
options: Someone might be spying on the station.
Someone might spy on the station.
Someone must be spied the station.
Someone might being spying on the station.

quiz.q: 为什么气球对飞机是极大危险？
options: Balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
Balloons can be a great danger of aircraft.
Balloons can make a great danger to aircraft.
Balloons are great dangerous to aircraft.

quiz.q: 气球降落后，警察为什么不能逮捕任何人？
options: Because the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer.
Because the balloon was too high to reach.
Because the men had already run away.
Because the police found no basket at all.

quiz.q: 文中乘客用来观察的“双筒望远镜”英语怎么说？
options: binoculars
a pair of glasses
an airfield
a spyglass
